Name: Bearded D'uccle - Chaos's Chicken Breed Replacer
Author: kichigaikikyokagome
Description:
I raise & show exhibition D'uccles and now you can to. Every rich farmer deserves some quality poultry!

White chicken --> Golden neck D'uccle  (Gold & white)
Brown Chicken --> Mille fleur D'uccle  (Brown/Black/White)
Blue Chicken --> Porcelain D'uccle (Blue/Cream/White)
Void Chicken --> Black Mottled D'uccle (Black & white) Choose from 2 versions, red eyes or no red eyes

Chicks included!

Directions:
1. Extract my files somewhere.
2. Open the folder. Pick a void chicken version and rename it "Void Chicken.xnb". Default is the red eyes version.

If Using Stardew Valley Mod Manager - 
3. Open SVMM. Click "Add SMAPI/XNB Mod"
4. Navigate to my extracted files. Open the folder. At the bottom, change "file name" to ".xnb" to view all .xnb files in the folder. Highlight all the .xnb files EXCEPT whichever void version you did not pick. Click "Open". Select "animal" for each .xnb.


OR Manual install:
3. Back-up any original game files before replacing them.  
4. Drag and drop all my .xnb files (except whichever void chicken version you did not pick) into the Stardew Valley game folder > Content > Animals
4. Allow files to overwrite.


Enjoy!
Also check out my Duck retexture mod to swap your ducks for the endangered Blue Whio duck of New Zealand, because your farm supports conservation.. and pretty waterfowl!
